value: NORMAL CLICK: THREE ANCHORS FIT INSIDE THE 400 MS RANGING BURST

Production schedule at the 50 ms minimum exchange stride. Eight sequential DS-TWR reservations fit exactly in the 400 ms burst; the round-robin order gives all three selected anchors at least two opportunities without overlapping the clicker's single DWM3000.

This part is physically feasible. The clicker uses one exchange at a time: A, B, C, A, B, C, A, B. Existing Channel-9 custody is preempted and retained during the burst, then delivery resumes after the ranging owner releases.
